authority: Owner-approved compact profile, 2026-10-16, extended 2026-11-01 (design audit approval: hierarchy sizes, ink and rule tokens, ornament budget, tailpiece sizing, section-head and opener composition); sole effective geometry/type/spacing authority for Typst and Python.

substrate.parchment_mode: light flat tone; no scanned stains, grain, vignette, or repeated texture

ink.note: Transparent black for hairlines and tints, drawn over the cream page colour; values are the ones Typst renders (design audit 2026-11-01, D-07).

ornament.family: the armoury: castle logo, chapter arms, and shields (docs/DESIGN.md 12), with tapered rules
ornament.note: Source horizontal rules set as the quiet separator; the castle flourish is reserved for chapter and front-matter boundaries (D-03).

art.ink_style: economical contour, deliberate hatch, readable silhouette, open negative space
art.tailpiece_note: A tailpiece grows to the gap it closes, up to its 300 ppi maximum and this cap, and sits at the foot of the frame when the gap is generous (D-02 f and g).

layout.float_figures_note: Full-width figures taller than the space left on the page float to the next page top (no half-page void).
layout.composition_note: Owner approval 2026-11-01: numbered section heads span the frame; the first numbered section shares the chapter-opener page when the measured opener and introduction leave more than opener_share_free_fraction of the frame free (set at 35% after measuring the illustrated openers, which leave 36 to 42% free; decided by the composer from the measurement pass); run_on_chapters do not start every section on a fresh page (heads are sticky to their columns); a tail shorter than tiny_tail_pt pulls back the previous piece.
